With ``minority_min_reads`` 2 or more, ``barcodes``, ``second_reads`` and the class count only the reads the rule keeps, and two columns are added: ``minority_ignored`` (reads left out) and ``minority_rescued`` (True when the cell is called only because of the rule). Under ``'weighted_majority'`` (:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`) the top barcode is the one with the most weight, and five columns are added. ``weight_top`` and ``weight_total`` are the summed read weights of the top barcode and of the cell. ``d_weight_top`` is the summed distance term of the top barcode's reads, and ``g_median_top`` their median nucleus distance (NaN without one). ``bleed_discounted`` counts the barcodes the neighbour discount weighed down.

With ``minority_min_reads`` 2 or more, ``barcodes``, ``second_reads`` and the class count only the reads the rule keeps, and two columns are added: ``minority_ignored`` (reads left out) and ``minority_rescued`` (True when the cell is called only because of the rule). Under ``'weighted_majority'`` (:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`) the top barcode is the one with the most weight, and five columns are added. ``weight_top`` and ``weight_total`` are the summed read weights of the top barcode and of the cell. ``d_weight_top`` is the summed distance term of the top barcode's reads, and ``g_median_top`` their median nucleus distance (NaN without one). ``bleed_discounted`` counts the barcodes the neighbour discount weighed down.
records.translation: किसी भी रीड वाली हर कोशिका के लिए एक पंक्ति: ``keys``, ``reads``, ``matched`` (सटीक या सुधारे गए), ``exact``, ``corrected``, ``ambiguous``, ``collision``, ``out_of_library``, ``barcodes`` (विशिष्ट कॉल योग्य बारकोड), शीर्ष बारकोड के ``prefix``, ``guide``, ``gene`` और ``level`` (खाली, जब तक ``perfect`` या ``great`` न हो), ``top_reads``, ``top_exact``, ``top_share`` (मिलान वाले रीड का), ``second_reads``, ``has_exact_read`` और ``quality``। ``minority_min_reads`` 2 या अधिक होने पर ``barcodes``, ``second_reads`` और वर्ग केवल उन रीड को गिनते हैं जिन्हें नियम रखता है, और दो कॉलम जुड़ते हैं: ``minority_ignored`` (बाहर रखे गए रीड) और ``minority_rescued`` (True जब कोशिका केवल इस नियम के कारण कॉल होती है)। ``'weighted_majority'`` (:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`) के अंतर्गत शीर्ष बारकोड वह है जिसके पास सबसे अधिक भार हो, और पाँच कॉलम जुड़ते हैं। ``weight_top`` और ``weight_total`` शीर्ष बारकोड और कोशिका के रीड भारों के योग हैं। ``d_weight_top`` शीर्ष बारकोड के रीड के दूरी पदों का योग है, और ``g_median_top`` उनकी माध्यिका नाभिक दूरी (उसके बिना NaN)। ``bleed_discounted`` उन बारकोडों को गिनता है जिनका भार पड़ोसी कटौती ने घटाया।

records.context: ``ops_read_distance_weight`` (item 988, alpha). ``'off'`` keeps the weights above. ``'decay'`` multiplies each read's weight by its distance term, and ``'distance_only'`` uses the distance term alone. The distance term is 1 up to ``interior_px`` and ``exp(-(g - interior_px) / decay_px)`` beyond it, at least ``min_weight``. A one-read guide then needs its quality times its distance term to reach ``single_read_quality``.

records.source: ``ops_read_distance_weight`` (item 988, alpha). ``'off'`` keeps the weights above. ``'decay'`` multiplies each read's weight by its distance term, and ``'distance_only'`` uses the distance term alone. The distance term is 1 up to ``interior_px`` and ``exp(-(g - interior_px) / decay_px)`` beyond it, at least ``min_weight``. A one-read guide then needs its quality times its distance term to reach ``single_read_quality``.
records.translation: ``ops_read_distance_weight`` (आइटम 988, अल्फ़ा)। ``'off'`` ऊपर के भार रखता है। ``'decay'`` हर रीड के भार को उसके दूरी पद से गुणा करता है, और ``'distance_only'`` केवल दूरी पद उपयोग करता है। दूरी पद ``interior_px`` तक 1 है और उसके आगे ``exp(-(g - interior_px) / decay_px)``, कम-से-कम ``min_weight``। तब एक-रीड गाइड को ``single_read_quality`` तक पहुँचने के लिए अपनी गुणवत्ता गुणा अपना दूरी पद चाहिए।
